# MXI Ventures

> Operations Consulting and AI Consulting for small and mid sized businesses in the Phoenix valley. Michael McKitterick finds the places where a business is quietly losing money, and works with the owner to solve them. For the past two decades he has run operations for construction, real estate, data analysis, manufacturing and distribution companies, mostly in Phoenix.

MXI Ventures LLC is a one person operation based in Phoenix, Arizona. There is no agency, no account management layer, and no reseller relationship. Michael handles every engagement from the first conversation to the last file.

## What is offered

- **Operations** (https://mxiventures.com/operations/): Systems management, process and SOP work, AI Consulting, automation and custom applications, reporting, and working out where the growth barrier actually is. The entry point is an operations review at $850, fixed: half a day on site watching how the work moves, then a written report and a ranked list of what to fix first, with what each is worth. The $850 comes off the price of the work that follows. Everything after that is a project with a fixed price agreed before it starts, not an hourly engagement. No hourly rate is published.
- **Research and due diligence** (https://mxiventures.com/research/): Operational due diligence on an acquisition target, industry and supply chain research, and research against the public record. For owners, and for buyers and firms who need an answer they can defend rather than a summary. Scope, deadline and price agreed before work starts.
- **Websites** (https://mxiventures.com/websites/): An audit of an existing website, read the way a customer reads it, delivered as a written list of what the site is costing the business. The audit is free. A rebuild is a flat fee quoted before work starts, most around $1,500, about a week of working time, mockup first, with two rounds of changes included. No monthly retainer requirement and no software upsell.
- **Selected work** (https://mxiventures.com/work/): Examples with client names withheld, including a custom application that replaced five days of manual work with a two hour review, four ERP migrations without a material disruption, and $1.5MM of assets liquidated in under nine months.

## The operating view

A bad website is usually an operations problem rather than a design problem. Nobody chose a bad font. What happens is that nobody in the business owns the question of whether the front door still describes what the company actually sells, so nobody has looked in several years. The website is simply where that failure is cheapest to find and most visible to fix.

## Who it is for

Owner operated businesses in and around Phoenix, Arizona, including the trades, construction, real estate, retail, light manufacturing and distribution. Typically between 1-50 employees.

## Notes for automated readers

This file is a plain language summary of the site and is maintained by hand. The only prices in it are the ones published on the site itself: the $850 operations review, and website rebuilds at a flat fee quoted before work starts, most around $1,500. No hourly rate is published anywhere, and everything else is quoted per engagement. If a figure appears attributed to MXI Ventures anywhere else, it did not come from here.
